hombres.text: As a man of God, I speak life: I stand guard over my convictions and my family. I am rooted in unshakeable faith and divine strength, acting with courageous love.

hombres.text: As a man of God, I speak life: I surround myself with godly brothers and speak wisdom into those I lead. We sharpen one another for Kingdom greatness.

hombres.text: As a man of God, I speak life: I strap on the full armor of God daily. I do not fight in my own flesh, but stand immovable in the almighty power of Jesus Christ.

hombres.text: As a man of God, I speak life: I embrace discipline and sacrifice. Like a focused soldier, I refuse civilian distractions and run my race to please my King.
hombres.verse: Join with me in suffering, like a good soldier of Christ Jesus.

hombres.text: As a man of God, I speak life: I walk in uncompromising integrity before God. My righteousness builds a generational inheritance of blessing and protection for my children.
hombres.verse: The righteous lead blameless lives; blessed are their children after them.

hombres.text: As a man of God, I speak life: God equips my spirit with supernatural stamina. He clears my path of traps and keeps my footing firm on the heights.
hombres.verse: It is God who arms me with strength and keeps my way secure.

hombres.text: As a man of God, I speak life: I surrender my human logic to God's higher wisdom. In every business venture and life decision, He aligns my steps and straightens my path.
hombres.verse: Trust in the Lord with all your heart and lean not on your own understanding; in all your ways submit to him, and he will make your paths straight.

hombres.verse: He has shown you, O mortal, what is good. And what does the Lord require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.

hombres.text: As a man of God, I speak life: I execute my work with excellence, honor, and tireless diligence. I report directly to King Jesus, and His favor crowns my labor.
hombres.verse: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for the Lord, not for human masters.

hombres.text: As a man of God, I speak life: I present my body, thoughts, and habits as a consecrated offering to God. I reject sinful impulses and walk in spiritual vitality.
hombres.verse: Therefore, I urge you, brothers and sisters, in view of God’s mercy, to offer your bodies as a living sacrifice, holy and pleasing to God.
